_readme: Reverse index for dge/js/ai.js's Dhatu word-tool: surface form -> {"c": Dhatupatha root code, "k": "<Lakara>.<purusha><vacana>"}. Built by tools/build_prakriya_form_index.py from the per-root files this directory already holds (see build_prakriya.py). Sharded by the form's first Devanagari codepoint (4 lowercase hex digits, e.g. उ -> 0909.json) so one word-click fetches one small shard, not the whole index. A form present under more than one (root, key) keeps only its first match by a deliberately chosen scan order — see the AMBIGUITY note in the build script's own docstring, not stored here to avoid drifting out of sync with it.
